definitions: A strategic business plan or membership tier, often offered by startups or new ventures, that provides early supporters with exclusive benefits, pricing, or influence in exchange for their initial commitment or investment.
A specific type of subscription or membership model designed to attract initial users or investors by offering unique advantages that may not be available to later participants.
examples: Many early adopters signed up for the Founder Plan.
The Founder Plan includes lifetime access to premium features.
We are closing enrollment for the Founder Plan next month.
